title: Old Yeller
plot: A teenage boy grows to love a stray yellow dog while helping his mother and younger brother run their Texas homestead while their father is away on a cattle drive. First thought to be good-for-nothing mutt, Old Yeller is soon beloved by all.
writer: Fred Gipson (screenplay by), William Tunberg (screenplay by), Fred Gipson (based on the book "Old Yeller" by)
actors: Dorothy McGuire, Fess Parker, Jeff York, Chuck Connors

title: Perri
plot: True-Life nature photography is used to tell the tale of a female tree squirrel named Perri who encounters many different forest creatures, both friendly and dangerous, as she grows up through the four seasons and finds a mate named Porro.
writer: Ralph Wright, Winston Hibler, Felix Salten (novel)
